mapper.select: SELECT vr.validation_run_id AS validationRunId, vr.validation_month AS validationMonth, vr.run_no AS runNo, vr.run_type AS runType, vr.status, vr.current_step AS currentStep, triggered.login_id AS triggeredBy, vr.started_at AS startedAt, vr.completed_at AS completedAt, finalized.login_id AS finalizedBy, vr.finalized_at AS finalizedAt, vr.failure_message AS failureMessage FROM fgc.validation_run vr LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user triggered ON triggered.user_id = vr.triggered_by LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user finalized ON finalized.user_id = vr.finalized_by WHERE vr.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}

SELECT vt.validation_target_id AS validationTargetId, ic.contract_no AS contractNo, vt.selection_status AS selectionStatus, p.product_name AS productName, po.offering_version AS offeringVersion, vt.refund_rate_table_id AS refundRateTableId, vt.selection_reason AS selectionReason FROM fgc.validation_target vt JOIN fgc.insurance_contract ic ON ic.contract_id = vt.contract_id JOIN fgc.product_offering po ON po.product_offering_id = vt.product_offering_id JOIN fgc.product p ON p.product_id = po.product_id WHERE vt.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} ORDER BY CASE vt.selection_status WHEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN 0 WHEN 'EXCLUDED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, vt.validation_target_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.validation_target WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND selection_status = 'SELECTED') AS targetSelectedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.validation_target WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND selection_status = 'EXCLUDED') AS targetExcludedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.validation_target WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND selection_status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED') AS targetReviewRequiredCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.cap_check WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}) AS capCheckedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.cap_check WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND result_status = 'VIOLATION') AS capViolationCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.cap_check WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND result_status = 'WARNING') AS capWarningCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.cap_check WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND result_status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED') AS capReviewRequiredCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.arbitrage_check WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}) AS arbitrageCheckedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.arbitrage_check WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND result_status = 'CANDIDATE') AS arbitrageCandidateCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.arbitrage_check WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND result_status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED') AS arbitrageReviewRequiredCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.journal_header WHERE validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}) AS journalCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.journal_header jh JOIN fgc.vw_journal_imbalance vji ON vji.journal_header_id = jh.journal_header_id WHERE jh.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}) AS journalImbalanceCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.reconciliation_result rr JOIN fgc.reconciliation_run recon ON recon.reconciliation_run_id = rr.reconciliation_run_id WHERE recon.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}) AS reconciliationResultCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.reconciliation_result rr JOIN fgc.reconciliation_run recon ON recon.reconciliation_run_id = rr.reconciliation_run_id WHERE recon.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND rr.result_type <> 'MATCHED') AS reconciliationMismatchCount
